bagPolicy.summary: Bags, purses and backpacks larger than 12 × 6 × 12 inches are prohibited; smaller bags are subject to the event security policy.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The house policies do not give a fixed concert parking lot or rate; check the operator’s venue information.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue FAQ does not designate a rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Outside beverages and beverage containers, including bottles, cups and flasks, are prohibited. Halo Bar provides a preshow bar and early entry when space permits.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The Pageant uses ramps to reach its tiers and provides an elevator; contact staff about an accessible viewing arrangement.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Guests over 21 may re-enter with a valid hand stamp or wristband. Guests under 21 cannot re-enter after leaving.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The house policies and venue FAQ do not publish a universal will-call pickup rule.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The Halo Bar offers early admission before the main doors for concert ticket holders, subject to capacity. Check the show listing for the main door time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
